interactions.note: The epitope of anti-idiotype Fab 409.5.3 on the idiotype Fab 730.1.4 was determined from the crystal structure of the complex, solved by molecular replacement.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.9 angstroms

The epitope of the anti-Fab Nb on the anti-BRIL antibody kappa light chain was determined determined from the single-particle cryo-EM reconstruction of a ternary complex of BRIL fusion hFzd5 (hFzd5ICL3BRIL) protein, anti-BRIL Fab and an anti-Fab nanobody (Nb) to a resolution of 3.7 Å. The BRIL/Fab/Nb module was designed as a ‘fiducial’ marker for particle image alignment.

The epitope for anti-hu kappa VHH on the Fab 1.2 light chain was determined by the crystal structure of the ternary complex containing the VHH, Fab1.2, and the PAS/#1 peptide.  The VHH was used as a crystallization chaperone.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 1.55 angstroms

The epitope for VHH anti-kappa on mAb XBB-9 was determined by the crystal structure of the ternary complex of anti-kappa, SARS-CoV2 Delta RBD, and mAb XBB-9.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 4.03 angstroms

The epitope of anti-Fab nanobody on the light chain of humanized antibody 2D4 was determined from the cryo-EM reconstruction of anti-Fab Nb bound to 2D4 Fab in complex with the ectodomain of CD132, at a resolution of 2.70 Å.

The epitope for anti-kappa VHH on mAb HU-38 was determined by single particle reconstruction cryo-electron microscopy of the VHH bound to Fab HU-38 bound to the PRAME 425/A2 pMHC complex at a resolution of 2.72 Å,  The VHH was included in the complex as a chaperone.

The epitope for the epitope specific VHH was determined from the crystal structure of the ternary complex containing Fab 8M2110 bound to VACV A26/OPG153 and the VHH.  The VHH was included in the complex as a chaperone.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.9 angstroms

The epitope for the epitope specific VHH was determined from the crystal structure of the ternary complex containing Fab 10M2146 bound to VACV A26/OPG153 and the VHH.  The VHH was included in the complex as a chaperone.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.9 angstroms
